title: Midnight Stomach Growl Mystery

scenes.text: Your stomach growls at midnight in the quiet house.
People think the rumble means you’re starving.
scenes.label: Growl Means Hunger

scenes.text: In reality, it’s the movement of gas and fluids as the intestines contract, even when no food is present.
scenes.label: Intestine Contractions Cause Noise

scenes.text: Your gut talks, not your hunger.
scenes.label: Gut Talk
scenes.sub: Sounds come from muscle activity, not empty stomach.

scenes.text: Follow if you love learning something new.

description: Ever wondered why your belly rumbles in the dead of night? The truth lies in intestinal waves, not empty plates. Follow for more hidden body truths!
